spec_match.rationale: Models exactly the two policies chromestatus names as the admin controls (SafeBrowsingProtectionLevel 0/1/2/unset, SafeBrowsingAllowlistDomains suffix matching) and is explicit that the page executes documented semantics client-side because policies are unreadable from page JS, pointing to chrome://policy for ground truth.

interactive.rationale: Level select, allowlist textarea, and test-URL input recompute a traced outcome on every input; a copy button provides the chrome://policy launch point with honest success/failure status.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index promises policy-outcome modelling including the level-0 footgun; the lab computes and labels precisely that.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers unset-policy delegation to user choice, level-0 losing interstitials too, level-1 tier exclusion, suffix vs exact host matching, invalid allowlist entries (ignored with an explanatory trace line), and unparseable URLs.

references.rationale: Links the chromestatus entry and both chromeenterprise.google policy pages.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite's enterprise-policies-control-warning manual assertion pins this contract with the policy documentation as source; the lab is the guided path for a human to verify it on a managed machine.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP harness verified all five outcome branches (allowlist match, level 2 popup-possible, level 0, level 1, invalid URL) plus honest copy-status feedback; zero console errors; both class screenshots captured post-interaction.

telemetry_health.rationale: ssw-policy-eval-ran asserts each evaluation with host/level/match context, including the parse-failure branch.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; outcome kinds use accent borders on ivory with charcoal/black text (AA); trace rows are stone-on-black text pairs that pass AA.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled select/textarea/input, aria-live result region announcing recomputed outcomes, visible focus on all fields, copy status in its own polite live region.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 0px horizontal overflow at both classes; controls collapse to a single column and the copy button goes full-width under 640px; mobile screenshot legible throughout.

openQuestions.title: Confirm SafeBrowsingAllowlistDomains matching granularity against Chromium source
openQuestions.detail: The lab implements the documented hostname-suffix semantics (entry matches host or any subdomain). A source-level read of the allowlist matcher (components/safe_browsing) would pin whether matching is on dot-boundary suffixes exactly as modelled, and whether invalid entries are ignored or rejected wholesale.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel forms without horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep multi-control panels usable on narrow viewports by letting fields wrap to full width with box-sizing accounted for.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The controls grid uses auto-fit minmax(250px,1fr) with min-width:0 children and width:100% + border-box fields; measured 0px overflow at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.query: invalid input error feedback live region
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Surface error states through the same announced channel as success states so non-visual users get equivalent feedback after interaction.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The invalid-URL branch renders into the same aria-live result region as normal outcomes, with a specific instruction to fix the URL field.

guidanceConsulted.query: copy to clipboard button with accessible status feedback
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Button-triggered actions need immediate, perceivable feedback tied to the invoking control.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each copy button has an adjacent per-button aria-live status; writeText is raced against a timeout so a pending permission can never leave the user with silent, stuck feedback — failure honestly says 'Copy blocked'.

summary: Edge/enterprise concept: a traced calculator for the two controlling policies, honest that it models documented semantics client-side with chrome://policy as ground truth. All five outcome branches harness-verified including both failure paths; copy feedback is timeout-guarded so it can never hang silently.
